product_one_liner.value: Momentus Technologies provides event and venue management software that helps venue operators and event professionals manage bookings, streamline operations, and increase revenue.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies bookings, event operations and venue revenue as core outcomes; the company job posting identifies event professionals and venue types as the audience. Sources: https://www.gomomentus.com/ and https://recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/Details/4563813

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists Enterprise and Elite plan tiers. Prices are quote-based, which still meets the requested definition. Source: https://www.gomomentus.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage's customer endorsement explicitly names Google and Microsoft. Source: https://www.gomomentus.com/ | named_customers.0: Google is explicitly named in the homepage's customer endorsement. | named_customers.1: Microsoft is explicitly named in the homepage's customer endorsement.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn page explicitly lists 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/57378

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's LinkedIn page explicitly lists St. Louis, Missouri as its headquarters. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/57378 | hq_country: The company's LinkedIn description explicitly places its headquarters in the United States. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/57378

founded_year.notes: The company's publication explicitly states that Momentus was founded in 1985. Source: https://infohub.gomomentus.com/hubfs/ebooks/How-to-Successfully-Choose-the-Right-Venue-and-Event-Management-Solution-for-Your-Business.pdf?hsLang=en

eng_blog.notes: The blog index and candidate-post review did not establish two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built. One post describes actual security implementation; the other plausible candidates are predominantly industry or procurement guidance by a product executive. This is false under the specified two-post threshold, not a claim that the site has no technical content. Sources: https://gomomentus.com/blog and https://gomomentus.com/blog/data-residency-requirements

public_docs.notes: Two public support articles link to regional API documentation, and the reference article identifies Enterprise OData, Enterprise Standard and Elite API collections. Sources: https://connectsupportcenter.ungerboeck.com/hc/en-us/articles/35430168339351-Public-Momentus-Connect-API-Now-Available and https://connectsupportcenter.ungerboeck.com/hc/en-us/articles/35490423637143-Momentus-API-Reference-Documentation

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Operations Manager posting has an application link and describes building and deploying AI/LLM tooling. Its title qualifies under the requested AI-title criterion. Source: https://recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/Details/4280768

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, with access to foundation models from Anthropic, Meta, Amazon and Cohere and model selection performed per task.
model_provider.notes: The product FAQ states that Momentus AI products run on AWS Bedrock, names the available foundation-model providers, and explains task-specific model selection. It does not establish that every named provider is used for every feature. Source: https://gomomentus.com/momentus-answers

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center names SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022 and PCI DSS; the ticketing product page explicitly claims GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a requested compliance claim, not as an independently issued certification. Sources: https://trustcenter.gomomentus.com/ and https://gomomentus.com/ticketing | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly named in the company's Trust Center. | compliance_certs.1: ISO 27001:2022 is explicitly named in the company's Trust Center. | compliance_certs.2: The ticketing page explicitly claims GDPR compliance. | compliance_certs.3: The Trust Center explicitly lists PCI DSS — SAQ D, Merchant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the latest deal type 'Debt - Acquisition.' Other databases have incomplete or conflicting funding coverage, so this is reported with medium confidence rather than treating the company as unfunded. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/233445-43 | funding_date: Unknown. A date for the latest acquisition-debt financing was not publicly disclosed in the reviewed profile. Acquisition dates and the older ownership transaction do not establish the date of this financing. Source reviewed: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/233445-43 | funding_amount_usd: Unknown. The reviewed funding profile identifies acquisition debt as the latest financing type but does not disclose its amount publicly. The reported $38.3 million is cumulative funding and cannot be substituted for the latest round. Source reviewed: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/233445-43

raised_18mo.notes: Unknown. Funding history exists, but the latest financing's date could not be established, so a yes/no answer for the preceding eighteen months would be speculative. Unrelated Momentus space-company financing announcements were excluded. Source reviewed: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/233445-43

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Account Executive job page identifies a full-time position and provides an active application action. Source: https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/MomentusTechnologies/744000109067005-account-executive

launched_6mo.notes: The September 15, 2026 announcement reports general availability of MAX for Sales, an AI-native CRM, within the preceding six months. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/momentus-technologies-launches-momentusmax-an-ai-platform-built-for-venues-and-brings-max-for-sales-to-general-availability-302878223.html

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated January 24, 2026 announcement names Joel Sackett as Chief Product Officer and James Hughes as Chief Technology Officer, within the preceding twelve months. Source: https://gomomentus.com/blog/momentus-technologies-strengthens-leadership-with-appointment-of-joel-sackett-as-chief-product-officer-and-james-hughes-as-chief-technology-officer

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Sales Operations Analyst posting explicitly names Salesforce as the primary platform, alongside HubSpot and Gong, as systems the employee will support.
